A '''nebula''' somewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was the site of a [[Unidentified space battle (Oteg)|battle]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] took command of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Sarapin Wanderer]]'' and drove their attackers into the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], the gases of which ignited when the Imperial vessels returned fire.
